plotEn:
Tad Stones is now living in London and has been married with his fiancée, Sara Lavrof, and together, they raise their 2-year-old daughter, Olimpia. One day, Tad and Mummy are alerted by Sara, their robot Archeobot and Ra Amon Ah, as they are pursued by a Persian man (described as handsome by Ra Amon Ah) named Suleiman, descendent of Suleiman the Magnificent for a lamp, first discovered by Aladdin. Sara explains that, at the end of the 19th century, an English explorer found the lamp, and brought it to the Buckingham Palace at the British Empire as a gift to Queen Victoria. She is initially displeased with the lamp at first, but when she rubbed it, she unintentionally summoned a genie. After granting three wishes of inventing common types of hats, she hid the lamp in a glass case.
The group visit a secret entry, and open a secret entrance leading to Victoria's office in Buckingham Palace. Mummy and Ra acquire the lamp and grant their three wishes; the first two gives pets Belzoni and Jeff the ability to talk, the final one brings the pair, and Sara and Belzoni to Paititi in 1502. There, they are captured by a guardian named Tupac and brought before its king. Mummy learns that Tupac is actually his self 500 years prior.
